items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Charley came to New York with Smalls, and they again used the name Paradise.

ctx.x: Cause there was an owner down there named Max Weloff, Ray Weloff. And Ray Weloff had this Paradise down at Atlantic City. And Charley made it into a legend. And people come from all over to go to the Ray Weloff's Paradise. And for Charley Johnson. Then when Ray went out of the business, Charley came to New York with Smalls, and they again used the name Paradise. And so, now he's got a new life, and 'til today people speak of Small's Paradise. But it really should have been Charley Johnson's Paradise.
